title: Before & After Mould Remediation - Brisbane Black Mould Removal Transformation
description: Dramatic before and after comparison of professional mould remediation in Brisbane property showing complete black mould removal and restoration. Left side displays extensive black mould growth on walls and ceiling with health hazard contamination. Right side shows completely clean, treated, and restored surfaces with no mould visible, demonstrating IICRC Mould Remediation certified expertise. Project addresses Brisbane's humid subtropical climate mould issues with proper containment, HEPA filtration, antimicrobial treatment, and moisture control. Completed in 3-5 days with 100% mould clearance testing, representing typical $8,000-$15,000 mould remediation by Brisbane's leading mould specialists with 25+ years experience protecting families from health hazards.
